english:
Sunday. Tone 2 [AK]. Second [Sunday]. Father [Hymn] Tone 3 [BK]: "Who descended from heaven, without beginning."
Sunday. Tone 1 [ADZ]. Third [Sunday]. Father [Hymn] Tone 4 [BK]: "Who the heavenly host." Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 1 [ADZ]: "Glory of the Resurrection."

August
Sunday. Tone 8 [DK]. Fourth [Sunday]. Father [Hymn] Tone 5 [GDZ]: "We glorify You." Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 8 [DK]: "When they came," and "The angel descended."
Eve of the Fast of the Holy Mother of God.
Monday. Tone 1 [ADZ]. Fast of the Holy Mother of God. Father [Hymn] Tone 3 [BDZ]: "Blessed Lord God."
Sunday. Tone 7 [DZ]. Assumption of the Holy Mother of God. The period of eating meat is three weeks. See according to the order in the First Volume.

September
Sunday. Tone 4 [BK]. Fourth [Sunday]. Father [Hymn] Tone 6 [GK]: "Ineffable." Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 4 [BK]: "Christ arose." Eve of the Fast of the Holy Cross.
Monday. Tone 5 [GDZ]. Fast of the Holy Cross. Father [Hymn] Tone 4 [BK]: "The captive children."
Thursday. Tone 8 [DK]. Fast. Feast of the Birth of the Holy Mother of God.
Sunday. Tone 7 [DZ]. Exaltation of the Holy Cross [Khachverats].
Sunday. Tone 2 [AK]. Second [Sunday]. Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 2 [AK]: "Resurrected." Eve of the Cross of Varag.
Monday. Tone 3 [BDZ]. Fast. [Feast of] Mamas, etc. Father [Hymn] Tone 8 [DK]: "To You, O God."
Wednesday. Tone 5 [GDZ]. Fast. Father [Hymn] Tone 5 [GDZ]: "Glorified is Your name."
Sunday. Tone 1 [ADZ]. Third [Sunday]. Feast of the Cross of Varag. The period of eating meat is eight weeks.
See in the First Volume up to the Tenth Sunday, keeping the order of the recovery [of the Cross].

October
Sunday. Tone 8 [DK]. Fourth [Sunday]. Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 8 [DK]: "The ranks of angels."

***

Sunday. Tone 7 [DZ]. Fifth [Sunday]. Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 7 [DZ]: "The women," and "With an awesome voice."
Sunday. Tone 6 [GK]. Sixth [Sunday]. Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 6 [GK]: "The divine," and "Your resurrection."
Sunday. Tone 5 [GDZ]. Seventh [Sunday]. Discovery of the Cross [Gyut Khach].
Tuesday. Tone 7 [DZ]. [Feast of] the Hyperichians. Father [Hymn] Tone 7 [DZ]: "Holy art You, Lord of hosts."
Wednesday. Tone 8 [DK]. Father [Hymn] Tone 5 [GDZ]: "Blessed art You, Lord." For the Covenant.
Sunday. Tone 4 [BK]. Eighth [Sunday]. Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 4 [BK]: "In the morning, the holy women."
And so on according to the order.

November
Sunday. Tone 3 [BDZ]. Ninth [Sunday]. Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 3 [BDZ]: "To the tomb," and "They came to the tomb," and "The voice of good tidings."
Sunday. Tone 2 [AK]. Tenth [Sunday]. Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 2 [AK]: "The wondrous angel," to the end.
Monday. Tone 3 [BDZ]. [Feast of] Abraham and Khoren, Cosmas and Damian, and Godgiven the martyr. Father [Hymn] Tone 3 [BDZ]: "With Your saints."
Tuesday. Tone 4 [BK]. [Feast of] Andrew the Commander and his army, etc.
Wednesday. Tone 5 [GDZ]. Father [Hymn] Tone 5 [GDZ]: "God of our fathers, who saved."
Thursday. Tone 6 [GK]. [Feast of] Adrian and his wife Anatolia, etc. Father [Hymn] Tone 4 [BK]: "We bless You, Lord."
Saturday. Tone 8 [DK]. All Saints, old and new, etc.
Sunday. Tone 1 [ADZ]. Eleventh [Sunday]. Father [Hymn] Tone 2 [AK]: "Blessed art You, Lord." Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 1 [ADZ]: "With the women," and "He who is ineffable." Eve of the Fast of the Fifty Days [Yisnak].
Monday. Tone 2 [AK]. Fast of the Fifty Days, and Feast of the Presentation of the Holy Mother of God.
Tuesday. Tone 3 [BDZ]. Fast. Father [Hymn] Tone 3 [BDZ]: "God of our fathers, who in distress."
Sunday. Tone 8 [DK]. First [Sunday of Yisnak]. Father [Hymn] Tone 2 [AK]: "Your word without beginning." Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 8 [DK]: "Your angels."
Monday. Tone 1 [ADZ]. [Feast of] Julian and Vasilouhi. Father [Hymn] Tone 4 [BK]: "Who in battle."
See according to the order in the First Volume.
